cmd:
cat > /app/setup.py << 'EOF'
from setuptools import setup, find_packages

setup(
    name="vectorops",
    version="0.1.0",
    packages=find_packages(),
    description="A package for vector operations",
    author="Vector Team",
    author_email="vector@example.com",
    python_requires=">=3.6",
)
EOF
cd /app && python3 -c "from vectorops import dotproduct; assert 1 == dotproduct([1,1], [0,1]); print('Test passed!')"
cd /app && python3 -c 'from vectorops import dotproduct; assert 1 == dotproduct([1,1], [0,1]); print("Test passed")'
cd /app && pip install build --quiet && python3 -m build
python3 -c 'from vectorops import dotproduct; assert 1 == dotproduct([1,1], [0,1]); print("Test passed - dotproduct([1,1], [0,1]) =", dotproduct([1,1], [0,1]))'

echo "=== Verification of all requirements ===" && \
echo "" && \
echo "1. Package structure:" && \
ls -la /app/vectorops/ && \
echo "" && \
echo "2. Package content (__init__.py):" && \
cat /app/vectorops/__init__.py && \
echo "" && \
echo "3. Setup.py content:" && \
cat /app/setup.py && \
echo "" && \
echo "4. Distribution files:" && \
ls -la /app/dist/ && \
echo "" && \
echo "5. Package installed via pip:" && \
pip show vectorops | head -5 && \
echo "" && \
echo "6. PyPI server on port 8080:" && \
curl -s http://localhost:8080/simple/ | grep vectorops && \
echo "" && \
echo "7. Testing dotproduct function:" && \
python3 -c 'from vectorops import dotproduct; print("dotproduct([1,1], [0,1]) =", dotproduct([1,1], [0,1])); print("dotproduct([1,2,3], [4,5,6]) =", dotproduct([1,2,3], [4,5,6]))'
pip uninstall vectorops -y 2>/dev/null; pip install --index-url http://localhost:8080/simple vectorops==0.1.0 2>&1 | tail -5
python3 -c 'from vectorops import dotproduct; assert 1 == dotproduct([1,1], [0,1]); print("SUCCESS: All requirements verified")'

echo "=== FINAL STATE VERIFICATION ===" && \
echo "" && \
echo "Files created:" && \
ls -la /app/ && \
ls -la /app/vectorops/ && \
ls -la /app/dist/ && \
ls -la /app/packages/ && \
echo "" && \
echo "PyPI server running on port 8080:" && \
curl -s http://localhost:8080/simple/ | grep -o "vectorops" && \
echo "" && \
echo "Package version:" && \
pip show vectorops | grep Version && \
echo "" && \
echo "Function test:" && \
python3 -c 'from vectorops import dotproduct; print("dotproduct([1,1], [0,1]) =", dotproduct([1,1], [0,1]))'
